description: This file defines interfaces for GStreamer capabilities within the Rialto media server component, including a factory class for creating capabilities instances and methods to query supported MIME types.

classes.name: IGstCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying GStreamer capabilities, such as supported MIME types.

classes.name: IGstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IGstCapabilities.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton factory instance for creating IGstCapabilities objects.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a new IGstCapabilities instance.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported by GStreamer for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported by GStreamer.
